final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ordervault AS reference, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin GROUP BY ordervault), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.reference, s1.record_count, 1.0 * s1.record_count / s2.total_count AS ratio FROM step1 AS s1 JOIN step2 AS s2 ON s2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS average_count FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s3.record_count, s3.ratio, s3.record_count - s4.average_count AS difference FROM step3 AS s3 JOIN step4 AS s4 ON s4.average_count IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.record_count > s4.average_count) SELECT SUM(record_count), AVG(ratio), AVG(difference) FROM step5
